title: Looking Forward to Constructing Better Causal Comparisons
abstract: arXiv:2611.02061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constructing credible comparison groups is a central challenge in observational causal inference. Conventional approaches assess comparability through observed characteristics or pre-treatment outcome trajectories, although causal identification depends on unobserved untreated potential outcomes after treatment. We propose a forward-looking framework that selects or weights controls using prognostic scores: predictions, based on pre-treatment information, of the outcomes units would experience without treatment. These scores target either untreated outcome levels or changes, depending on the comparability condition underlying the causal design. They can be estimated using post-treatment outcomes observed for untreated units or exclusively from historical data. translated_title: 展望未来：构建更优的因果比较组
translated_abstract: 在观察性因果推断中，构建可信的对照组是一个核心挑战。传统方法通过观测到的特征或处理前的结果轨迹来评估可比性，然而因果识别实际上依赖于处理后被处理个体在未处理情形下未被观测到的潜在结果。我们提出了一个前瞻性框架，利用预后得分来选择或加权对照个体：预后得分是基于处理前信息、对个体在未接受处理情形下将会经历的结果的预测。根据因果设计所依据的可比性条件，这些得分既可以针对未处理结果的水平，也可以针对其变化。这些得分可以利用在未处理个体上观测到的处理后结果进行估计，也可以完全从历史数据中获得。为了构建这些得分，我们借助了表格基础模型，其大规模预训练使其能够捕捉预测变量之间的复杂关系，并有效提取……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个前瞻性框架，利用基于处理前信息、由表格基础模型估计的预后得分来选择或加权对照组，使对照选择直接指向因果识别所依赖的未处理潜在结果，从而构建更可信的因果比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a forward-looking framework that constructs more credible causal comparison groups by selecting or weighting controls using prognostic scores—predictions of untreated potential outcomes derived from pre-treatment information via tabular foundation models.
